name: Michael Dobson
bio: Michael Richard Dobson (born January 18, 1966) is one of the three Dobson brothers (himself, Brian, and Paul), all of whom have made themselves known prominently in the voice acting community. He currently resides in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. Dobson tends to be cast into the role of well-rounded, emotionally-driven characters.
